notes.title: Elden 2021 Update Log #1
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Onerat Dylan here, developer of Elden of the Forgotten. [/h2]

Creating a game is a hard thing to do, let alone making one solo. I personally burnt out during the development cycle and didn't deliver the product I was hoping to create.  

I’ve seen the Lets Plays and read the reviews and I understand your misgivings with the current game.

To that end, I've been working on what at this point can only be described as an overhaul. Every element of the game is getting the attention it deserves. 

Here I've listed some of the major changes I've implemented so far. Note that this is in no way a complete change log for the Elden Path of the Forgotten overhaul.

Iv been slack with posting development updates to Steam, but with this announcement that is something I plan on changing. Keep an eye out for future announcements and forum posts detailing the coming overhauled version of Elden: Path of the Forgotten.

If you have any suggestions or feedback with this overhaul in mind, I'm always happy to listen. You easily reach me at [url=discord.gg/oneratgames.]discord.gg/oneratgames.[/url]

notes.content:
[h1]Succumb to a world of Ancient Horror![/h1]

[u][b]Elden: Path of the Forgotten[/b][/u] is part of a new wave of classic 16 and 8 bit style games, such as Hyper Light Drifter and Children of Morta, and was described as "[b]darker and more unsettling that Salt & Sanctuary or Titan Souls[/b]" by PC Gamer’s Fraser Brown. 

Elden is a somber, intriguing, and exquisite journey that invites the players to discover a narrative by themselves.
 
[previewyoutube=XSavq28Kf7U;full][/previewyoutube]

•	Explore a cryptic and disturbing world that combines challenge with a unique visual narrative.
•	Master a range of weapons in impressive battles against Eldritch creatures.
•	Harness unearthly powers with dreadful, unearthly spells.
•	Corrupt your sanity with a gorgeous haunting, minimalist soundtrack.

notes.title: A Look Into The Weird History of Elden: Path of the Forgotten
notes.content:
So I've been doing a little research into where Elden: Path of the Forgotten came from. Honestly, I was kinda surprised to find out that the idea of the game seems to be much older than I expected.

You can check out the video below for full details.

[previewyoutube=0xPkpYsetSg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Summary[/h1]

So for those of you unable to watch, the summary is that when going through some old dream journals, I discovered that I'd been thinking (or at least drawing) concepts from Elden for a LOT longer than I though I had. It's kinda cool to see the subconcious at work but also a bit weird to realize that I'm even more connected to the game than I thought.

Below is the extract from the Dream Journal so you can see what I'm talking about. The Bird and the lone hero are definitely Elden and even the monsters bear an uncanny resemblence to enemies in the game. 

[url=https://discord.gg/p3jJsSE][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32379354/96850a6bd17867211613a167cd6b0dbc3bd67fc5.jpg[/img]
[/url]

I am going to go through some more stuff and see if I can dig anything else up.
